LESSON: SOCIO- ECONOMIC PRACTICES OF EARLY HUMANS

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Strand: People and Relationships
Topic 3.1: Socio- Economic Practices of Early Humans

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Socio- Economic Practices of Early Humans. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How do socio- economic practises of early humans impact the modern society?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. describe the socio- economic practices of early humans in Africa during the Stone Age period

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: SOCIO- ECONOMIC PRACTICES OF EARLY HUMANS
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES · Grade: Grade 9
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Socio- Economic Practices of Early Humans helps you succeed in SOCIAL STUDIES. You will understand it, practise it, and use it in your county, school, and Kenyan community.

KEY FACTS: SOCIO- ECONOMIC PRACTICES OF EARLY HUMANS
Good citizens follow rules, respect others, and care for shared places.
Kenyan examples: lining up, keeping the compound clean, telling the truth, helping a classmate.
Rights come with responsibilities.

PART 1: Describe the socio- economic practices of early humans in Africa during the Stone Age period

What this means
In this part you learn to describe the socio- economic practices of early humans in Africa during the Stone Age period. You will use ideas from in your county, school, and Kenyan community.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: describe the socio- economic practices of early humans in Africa during the Stone Age period.
2. Locate, explain, then act responsibly using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Locate: Connect “Socio- Economic Practices of Early Humans” to a real place or group in Kenya (school, market, county office, home).

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can describe the socio- economic practices of early humans in Africa during the Stone Age period. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Socio- Economic Practices of Early Humans is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Good citizens follow rules, respect others, and care for shared places.

Kenyan examples: lining up, keeping the compound clean, telling the truth, helping a classmate.

Example 1: Connect “Socio- Economic Practices of Early Humans” to a real place or group in Kenya (school, market, county office, home). (skill: describe the socio- economic practices of early humans in Africa during the Stone Age period)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Socio- Economic Practices of Early Humans to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: describe the socio- economic practices of early humans in Africa during the Stone Age period.
3. Make one local Kenya example of Socio- Economic Practices of Early Humans from your county, market, farm, or school.
4. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Socio- Economic Practices of Early Humans: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 9 learner study Socio- Economic Practices of Early Humans?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How do socio- economic practises of early humans impact the modern society?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Socio- Economic Practices of Early Humans means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: describe the socio- economic practices of early humans in Africa during the Stone Age period.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
